Headline: Promoter Shares of KBL, NIMB, And GBBL in Auction From Today
Full Content:
The existing promoter of
Nepal Investment Mega Bank Limited (NIMB)
is auctioning 1,90,695 units of shares to existing promoter shareholders from today i.e. 8th Ashwin, 2081.
1,90,695 unit promoter shares of NIMB will be auctioned. Only existing promoters are eligible to bid for the auction within 35 days from the date of publication of this notice, i.e. 8th Ashwin.
All interested shareholders are required to submit their bids at the central office of the bank, conveniently situated in Lazimpat, Kathmandu. If no bids are received from existing founder shareholders within the specified timeframe, the shares will later be open for auction to the general public.
As of writing, NIMB has an LTP of Rs. 224.00. Meanwhile, NIMBPO closed at Rs. 171.60.

Headline: Existing Promoter Shareholders Of Garima Bikas Bank Auctioning 1,09,811 Unit Promoter Shares From Today
Full Content:
The existing promoters of
Garima Bikas Bank Limited (GBBL)
are auctioning 1,09,811 unit promoter shares to the shareholders from today i.e 26th Shrawan and will conclude on 31st Bhadra, 2079.
1,09,811 unit promoter shares will be auctioned. Rs. 100 is the minimum bid rate for the auction. While the minimum bid quantity for shares is 1000 units, there is no upper limit to bid for the shares. Although bidders can bid for the entirety of the issue, they are required to abide by Nepal Rastra Bank's rule to not exceed the specified quantity of shares per entity. Only the shareholders of the bank are all eligible to bid for the auction.
NIBL Ace Capital Limited is appointed the auction manager. Bids will open at the premises of auction manager on Ashoj 02, starting from 2 pm that day. As of writing, the LTP of GBBL is Rs. 400.
